lines.en: I stride across the sand.
I'm covered in spikes.
Each step kicks up dust.
These gloves weigh on my shoulders.
Desert wind passes over me.
I stop and look.
My spikes shine in the sun.
I take another step.
The sand gives slightly.
I head toward the badlands.

lines.zh: 我不赶时间，一脚一脚走。
lines.en: No rush. One foot at a time.
I stand, spikes upright.
This outfit isn't very comfortable.
I raise a glove and study it.
It's covered in scratches.
After looking, I lower it.
Standing here, the desert is hot.
Sand grains cling to my cactus spines.

lines.zh: 沙漠晒得烫，风还夹着沙。
lines.en: The desert burns, and the wind carries sand.
Sand in the air. I narrow my eyes.
Eyes narrowed, I wait.
Where there are plants, there am I.

lines.zh: 沙在下面流，我挪了挪脚。
lines.en: Sand flowing beneath, I shift my feet.

lines.zh: 我换了个站姿，沙从脚下滑走。
lines.en: I shift my stance and sand slips away.
The sand slides away. I plant myself again.

lines.zh: 我转身与你正面相对，你比我矮。
lines.en: I turn square to you. You're shorter.

lines.zh: 你个头不及我，我举起拳套。
lines.en: Shorter than me. I raise a glove.
The glove rises halfway, then drops.

lines.zh: 我放下拳套，你站得很稳。
lines.en: Glove lowered, and you're standing steady.
You're planted. So am I.

lines.zh: 我也立着，两边谁也没动。
lines.en: I'm standing too. Neither moves.
Sand blows between us.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹过来，我歪了歪头。
lines.en: Sand blows between us. I tilt my head.
I don't want trouble either.

lines.zh: 瞧你不像来找茬的，那就这样。
lines.en: You don't look like trouble. Leave it.
Let's leave it. I step aside.

lines.zh: 我让开一步，你尽可过去。
lines.en: I step aside. You can pass.
I hold a glove in front of me.
There's nowhere to hide in the desert.
The blow makes me sway.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，刺断了一根。
lines.en: Struck, and a spike snaps.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺折断，我没吭声。
lines.en: A spike snaps. I make no sound.
I brace a glove on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一声没出，伤口里进了沙。
lines.en: No sound from me. Sand in the wound.
Bracing my knees, I stand.
Sand in the wound, and the wind won't stop.

lines.zh: 风仍在刮，这一击着实沉。
lines.en: The wind blows on. That blow was heavy.

lines.zh: 这一击分量十足，我记下。
lines.en: That one had weight. Noted.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住，还能再战。
lines.en: I remember it. I can still fight.
That in your hand. Is it a plant?

lines.zh: 那算是植物么？我端详着。
lines.en: Is that a plant? I look closer.
I study it. Not quite.
Not quite, but I eat it anyway.
Eating it, it's a bit dry.
Everything here is dry.

lines.zh: 这地方什么都干巴巴，多谢你。
lines.en: Everything here is dry. Thank you.
I'll look elsewhere.
Anything left in your hand?

lines.zh: 还有别的东西吗？没有就算了。
lines.en: Anything else? Never mind if not.
I sniff it. Like dry grass.

lines.zh: 这地方的东西都不够吃。
lines.en: Nothing here is enough to eat.
You bump me and get pricked.

lines.zh: 我被尖刺扎到，退了小半步。
lines.en: A spike pricks me. I step back.
The spikes weren't aimed at you.

lines.zh: 刺不是冲你的，我侧过身。
lines.en: The spikes weren't aimed at you. I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 我转成侧面，这样稳妥些。
lines.en: I turn sideways. Better.

lines.zh: 这样舒服些，你搓了搓手。
lines.en: Better now, and you rub your hand.

lines.zh: 你揉着手，我有点过意不去。
lines.en: You rub your hand. I feel a bit bad.
My gloves are heavy.

lines.zh: 拳套分量不轻，我却不打算用。
lines.en: Heavy gloves, and I'd rather not.
I won't use the gloves. Go on.

lines.zh: 往后我会长成另一副模样。
lines.en: One day I’ll take another shape.
Lilimon, or Mamemon.
For this stage, this is it.
I lift a glove.
That's for enemies.
Not for this.

lines.zh: 继续走之前，我把手放下。
lines.en: Before walking on, I put my hand down.

lines.zh: 手臂垂回身侧，我接着上路。
lines.en: My arm drops. I walk on.
More sand ahead. The desert is vast.
I'm fine on my own.
I pinch it with a glove.
A spike nearly pricked me.
I set it down carefully.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠无边，大得过头。
lines.en: The desert is vast. Too vast.
I pick up a smaller one.

lines.zh: 我拾起一小块，这个能用。
lines.en: I pick up a small piece. This will do.
This will do. I tuck it in my belt.

lines.zh: 我把东西掖进腰带，接着翻。
lines.en: Tucked in my belt, I keep searching.
Keep looking. There's more in the sand.
More under the sand. I crouch.
Something's coming closer.

lines.zh: 有东西凑过来，我扭身相对。
lines.en: Something nears. I turn to face it.

lines.zh: 我扭过身，双拳已经收紧。
lines.en: I swing around, fists tight.

lines.zh: 双拳一紧，满身尖刺倒竖。
lines.en: Fists tighten, and every spike rises.
But it can't come closer.
Sand underfoot. I plant my feet.
Feet set, and it moved.
It moved. I've marked it.

lines.zh: 我盯死它，已进了一步之内。
lines.en: I've got it, well within reach.
Close enough. I'm ready.
I don't want to fight. But I will.
It circles me. I turn with it.
The sand makes me unsteady.

lines.zh: 沙地打滑站不住，我把重心压低。
lines.en: The sand shifts. I lower my center.
Center low, it lunges.
I raise an arm to block.
One spike after another pierces hide.

lines.zh: 我身上的尖刺扎进它皮里，它往后缩。
lines.en: My spikes bite its hide, and it pulls back.
I only hold. It circles again.
It circles. From behind this time.
Sand runs from under my feet.
I throw a punch.
The glove lands.

lines.zh: 拳套实打实砸中，它被轰开。
lines.en: The glove lands squarely. It's blasted back.
My spikes rake its hide.
I didn't use full force.

lines.zh: 我没使全力，只想逼它后退。
lines.en: I held back. Only meant to push it off.

lines.zh: 它又冲上来，我一拳打空。
lines.en: It charges again. I miss.
Sand slides under me.

lines.zh: 脚下沙一滑，我稳住身形。
lines.en: The sand slips. I steady myself.
The second punch lands.

lines.zh: 第二拳结结实实，它退得老远。
lines.en: The second punch lands. It's thrown far.

lines.zh: 这一仗不好打，但我还站着。
lines.en: This isn't easy. But I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后走出来，刺上挂着沙。
lines.en: Out from the dune, sand on my spikes.

lines.zh: 尖刺上挂着沙，这地干得厉害。
lines.en: Sand on my spikes. It's very dry here.
The sun falls on it.
I look toward anything green.
Step by step, I move ahead.

lines.zh: 地面干裂，沙面印满足迹。
lines.en: The ground is parched and tracked all over.

lines.zh: 沙面上有足印，不是我的。
lines.en: Prints in the sand. Not mine.

lines.zh: 顺着走了一段，前面有动静。
lines.en: I follow a way. Something ahead.

lines.zh: 前头有了响动，我攥紧双拳。
lines.en: A noise ahead. I clench my fists.
It might not be an enemy.
But I must be ready.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的刺，发出焦味。
lines.en: Fire runs over my spikes, smelling scorched.
I hit the sand and sink halfway.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我却灌了一嘴。
lines.en: There's no water here, yet my mouth fills.
The blast throws sand over me.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的刺之间。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my spikes.
Light locks my gloves.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没水，拳套都垂了。
lines.en: No water in the desert; even my gloves droop.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，刺尖都冒火星。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my spike tips spark.

lines.zh: 我一路坠下去，沙也跟着落。
lines.en: I fall, and the sand falls with me.
